question: In India, the financial year runs from ____________ to _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**April 1, March 31.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India's financial year** starts on **April 1** and ends on **March 31** of the following year.
